from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,time,datetime
root=Path.cwd(); cache=Path('/workspace/blue-member-build')
out=root/'verification/part-a/current';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
expected=json.loads((root/'verification/part-a/source-manifest.json').read_text())
modules=[p[:-5].replace('/','.') for p in expected]
lake=root/'.lake';lake.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
packages=lake/'packages'
if not packages.exists():packages.symlink_to(cache/'.lake/packages',target_is_directory=True)
lock=json.loads((root/'lake-manifest.json').read_text())
pins=[]
for p in lock['packages']:
 d=packages/p['name']
 actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(d),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
 if actual!=p['rev']:raise RuntimeError('wrong dependency pin '+p['name'])
 if subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(d),'diff','--quiet','HEAD','--']).returncode:raise RuntimeError('modified dependency source '+p['name'])
 pins.append({'name':p['name'],'sha':actual})
copied=[]
for rel,h in expected.items():
 src=cache/rel
 if not src.exists() or hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=h:continue
 stem=Path(rel).with_suffix('')
 old=cache/'.lake/build/lib/lean'/stem
 for f in old.parent.glob(old.name+'.*'):
  dest=root/'.lake/build/lib/lean'/stem.parent/f.name
  dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copy2(f,dest)
 copied.append(rel)
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
env={'source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
 'Lean_version':subprocess.check_output(['lean','--version'],text=True).strip(),
 'source_tree':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip(),
 'dependency_revisions':pins,'cache_project':str(cache),'cache_sources_matching':copied,
 'compiler_sha256':digest(Path('/workspace/toolchains/lean-4.33.0-rc1-linux/bin/lean')),
 'checker_sha256':digest(Path('/workspace/toolchains/lean-4.33.0-rc1-linux/bin/leanchecker')),
 'commands':[], 'started_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
def saveenv():(out/'ENVIRONMENT.json').write_text(json.dumps(env,indent=2)+'\n')
saveenv()
def run(stage,argv):
 print('START',stage,flush=True);t=time.monotonic()
 with (out/(stage+'.log')).open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(argv,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 item={'stage':stage,'argv':argv,'exit_code':r.returncode,'runtime_seconds':time.monotonic()-t};env['commands'].append(item);saveenv()
 print('END',stage,r.returncode,round(item['runtime_seconds'],2),flush=True)
 if r.returncode:
  print('\n'.join((out/(stage+'.log')).read_text().splitlines()[-70:]),flush=True)
  raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
def snapshot(name):
 paths=[root/p for p in expected]+[root/'ImbalancedChen.lean',root/'lean-toolchain',root/'lake-manifest.json',root/'lakefile.toml',root/'verification/part-a/PartAAudit.lean']
 paths+=list(root.glob('.lake/build/lib/lean/**/*.olean*'))+list(root.glob('.lake/packages/*/.lake/build/lib/lean/**/*.olean*'))
 data={str(p.relative_to(root)):digest(p) for p in sorted(set(paths)) if p.is_file()}
 (out/name).write_text(json.dumps(data,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
 print('SNAPSHOT',name,len(data),flush=True)
run('build',['lake','build','ImbalancedChen'])
snapshot('OBJECTS_BEFORE.json')
run('checker',['lake','env','leanchecker','--verbose']+modules+['ImbalancedChen'])
run('types',['lake','env','lean','-t0','-M24576','-DwarningAsError=true','verification/part-a/PartAAudit.lean'])
snapshot('OBJECTS_AFTER.json')
env['finished_at_utc']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();saveenv()
print('PART_A_CURRENT_GATES_COMPLETED',flush=True)
